terrain/height_2048.u16.source: USGS Astrogeology, MRO HiRISE SOCET DTMs (NASA/JPL/University of Arizona/USGS)
terrain/height_2048.u16.transform: 4000 m square window centered at (137.4000E, -4.7450N), bilinear resample to 2048x2048 uint16

terrain/meta.json.source: USGS Astrogeology, MRO HiRISE SOCET DTMs (NASA/JPL/University of Arizona/USGS)
terrain/meta.json.transform: Bounding box, elevation range, and hole percentage metadata for the 4x4 km Gale Crater Mount Sharp window

terrain/svf_1024.png.source: USGS Astrogeology, MRO HiRISE SOCET DTMs (NASA/JPL/University of Arizona/USGS)
terrain/svf_1024.png.transform: Sky View Factor (cos^2 horizon angle), 16 azimuths, 1500 m radius, 1.6 m eye height, 1024x1024 uint8

terrain/slope_1024.png.source: USGS Astrogeology, MRO HiRISE SOCET DTMs (NASA/JPL/University of Arizona/USGS)
terrain/slope_1024.png.transform: Terrain slope in degrees (0-45 deg mapped to 0-255) by central differences on ~3.9 m grid

terrain/ortho_4096.webp.source: USGS Astrogeology, MRO HiRISE SOCET DTMs (NASA/JPL/University of Arizona/USGS)
terrain/ortho_4096.webp.transform: Co-registered HiRISE orthoimage window, 1-99 percentile contrast stretch, 4096x4096 WebP

terrain/thermal_class.png.source: USGS Astrogeology / ASU, Mars Odyssey THEMIS Controlled Night IR Mosaic (mc23_aeolis_nir)
terrain/thermal_class.png.transform: Qualitative 3-class tercile proxy (0=cold/loose, 127=medium/mixed, 255=warm/rock) over matching 4x4 km window, 1024x1024 uint8
terrain/thermal_class.png.notes: Qualitative proxy only; DN values are not converted to physical TIU units.

env/ephem.json.product_id: Target 399 (Earth) w.r.t. 499 (Mars) + Target 10 (Sun) at Gale site
env/ephem.json.transform: Extracted Earth-Mars one-way/round-trip light time (LT) and hourly solar azimuth/elevation at Gale scene center.

env/rad_quiet.json.source: NASA/SwRI PDS-PPI, MSL RAD RDR V1.0 (MSL-M-RAD-3-RDR-V1.0)
env/rad_quiet.json.transform: Extracted [DOSIMETRY_TOTAL_DOSE_B] absorbed dose rate in silicon (uGy/h) per observation; no quality factor applied.

env/rad_sep2017.json.source: NASA/SwRI PDS-PPI, MSL RAD RDR V1.0 (MSL-M-RAD-3-RDR-V1.0)
env/rad_sep2017.json.transform: Extracted [DOSIMETRY_TOTAL_DOSE_B] absorbed dose rate in silicon (uGy/h) during Sep 2017 SEP event; no quality factor applied.

env/rems_clear.json.source: NASA/CAB PDS Atmospheres, MSL REMS MODRDR V1.0 (mslrem_1001)
env/rems_clear.json.transform: Parsed via MODRDR6.FMT with missing-value filtering; hourly means across 3 clear pre-storm sols (May 2018).

env/rems_storm2018.json.source: NASA/CAB PDS Atmospheres, MSL REMS MODRDR V1.0 (mslrem_1001)
env/rems_storm2018.json.transform: 8-sol 2018 global dust storm sequence; relative opacity tau derived from REMS noon UV_ABC drop relative to clear baseline.

terrain/hydration_1024.png.source: Gradient Boosting ensemble (tango-horizon-hydration-v1) trained on MSL DAN passive neutron counts (PDS Geosciences MSL-M-DAN-3/4-RDR-V1.0) with MRO CRISM MTRDR (BD1900_2, SINDEX2), Mars Odyssey THEMIS IR (mc23_aeolis_nir, mc23_aeolis_dir), and MRO CTX DTM/DRG (USGS STAC)
terrain/hydration_1024.png.transform: 500 m spatial-block GroupKFold CV: R2=0.364, Spearman=0.582, MAE=0.370 vs baseline 0.486 (n=1567, blocks=36)

veins/index.json.source: Own classifier (frozen DINOv2-small features + sol-grouped logistic regression) on MSL Mastcam/MAHLI images (NASA/JPL-Caltech/MSSS)
veins/index.json.transform: 448x448 resize, dinov2-small-vits14 CLS + 32x32 patch tokens, GroupKFold(sol) precision=0.794, recall=0.659, roc_auc=0.845, p=0.0020, n=117

env/storm_forecast.json.source: NASA/CAB PDS Atmospheres MSL REMS MODRDR V1.0 (mslrem_1001) + MSL Mastcam-100 Optical Depths (msl_mmm_tau_bundle, Lemmon 2024)
env/storm_forecast.json.transform: Quantile HistGradientBoostingRegressor (q=0.1,0.5,0.9; horizons h=1,2,3 sols) with training-only LOMO-CV CQR calibration on REMS S1/S2 pressure-tide harmonics, daily ranges, noon UV, Ls, and 1/3/7-sol lags; Mars Year 34 held out entirely.
